title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial for both the mother's and baby's health. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 simple and nutritious cook-once recipes, helping pregnant women enjoy delicious and balanced dinners.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are designed to provide adequate protein, fiber, and calcium, essential nutrients for fetal development and maternal health. According to the [WHO](https://www.who.int/tools/elena/interventions/nutrition-counselling-pregnancy), nutrition during pregnancy plays a vital role in preventing health problems and ensuring the overall development of the fetus.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken and Potato Soup
Chicken and potato soup is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2-3 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- Chicken broth
- Seasoning

Cook the chicken and potatoes in chicken broth, add onion and garlic for extra flavor. This dish provides adequate protein and fiber.

### 2. Chicken and Vegetable Stir-Fry
Chicken and vegetable stir-fry is an excellent choice for dinner. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 1 cup of mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, green beans)
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 tablespoon of oil
- Seasoning

Stir-fry the chicken and vegetables in oil, add garlic for extra flavor. This dish provides adequate protein and fiber.

### 3. Fried Eggs and Salad
Fried eggs and salad is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 cup of mixed greens (lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers)
- 1 tablespoon of oil
- Seasoning

Cook the eggs and serve with salad. This dish provides adequate protein and fiber.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait
Yogurt parfait is a simple and nutritious dessert. To cook, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 cup of mixed fruits (strawberries, bananas, apples)
- 1 tablespoon of honey

Mix the yogurt and fruits, add honey for extra flavor. This dish provides adequate calcium and fiber.

### 5. Chicken and Rice Bowl
Chicken and rice bowl is a simple and nutritious meal. To cook, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 1 cup of cooked rice
- 1 cup of mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots, green beans)
- 2 cloves of garlic
- Seasoning

Cook the chicken and vegetables, serve with rice. This dish provides adequate protein and fiber.

## Practical Tips
- Always choose fresh and clean ingredients to ensure food safety.
- Cook food at the right temperature to avoid food poisoning.
- Add seasoning and herbs to enhance flavor and nutrition.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about nutrition during pregnancy, consult your doctor or a registered dietitian. You can also visit [our website](/blog) for more information on meal planning and nutrition for pregnant women.
